reviews.text:
My beloved dog was cared for by you for 15 years.

He suffered from many injuries and illnesses from a young age, and you treated him every time.

He was diagnosed with mitral valve insufficiency at the age of 8, but thanks to you, he was able to live a healthy life for nearly 7 years without the condition progressing.

Even when I was going through a difficult time emotionally, you came to see me even on your days off, and I was so grateful that you understood not only my dog's feelings but also mine.

Thank you so much for everything.

Dr. Sonoda and the nurses

Thank you so much.

Mameta and I were so happy.

You work so hard, so please make sure you get enough rest.

I live nearby, so it's within a 10-minute walk, which is why I used to go there out of necessity, but I won't be going anymore.

Spaying/neutering surgeries, nail trimming, etc., are more expensive than other animal hospitals. I suppose it's unavoidable given the location, but I never felt like I got anything worth the price, and the service was inconsistent, sometimes cold and impersonal.

Thanks to the loving care and attention I received from the doctor and staff, I, Dyna's mother (16 years and 10 months old), who was filled with anxiety, was able to say goodbye to her peaceful passing. We were truly fortunate to have been able to meet you all one last time. We are filled with gratitude.

I had my beloved dog cared for at this clinic until a few years ago.

The head veterinarian treated my dog ​​as if he were his own child. I was always impressed by his gentle gaze while examining my dog. I am also very grateful for his response when my dog ​​suddenly became ill.

If I ever have another pet in the future, I would like to use this clinic again.

The doctor isn't particularly friendly (sorry, doctor!), but he's calm and trustworthy.

Even though I was worried and stressed, the doctor's demeanor helped me calm down many times.

When we were choosing an ophthalmologist for cataract surgery, he listened to our family's wishes and made a referral.

When we went for a check-up after the surgery was successfully completed, he said, "That's great!" with a happy expression. I remember his smile that day as if it were yesterday.

Thank you so much, doctor and all the staff.

It's been three years since we moved. Our dog is now a senior, but he's doing well.

We have been using their services for over 15 years, and we cannot agree with any of the negative comments. They always consider the owner's approach and the dog's personality. We are worried about Dr. Sonoda's health, given how busy he is every day. Our whole family is deeply grateful to Dr. Sonoda and all the staff, and we have the utmost respect for them.

I absolutely do not recommend this clinic.

My cat fractured a bone, so I made an appointment to inquire about treatment costs, hospitalization period, and surgical options. Despite having an appointment, I was kept waiting for a very long time...

In the end, all I got was, "You only want to know about the treatment costs, right? It's XX million yen. Okay."

The attitude was like, "Can you hurry up?"

I understand they're busy, but I had made an appointment and told them I wanted to discuss various things, so it was very unpleasant.

In terms of trustworthiness and whether I could entrust my cat to them with peace of mind, it was the worst, and I couldn't understand why they charged me 6000 yen for such a terrible experience.

It seems they only care about taking the money.


P.S.
Thank you for your reply.

That's more of an excuse than an apology.

The vet gets emotional very easily. They don't offer any support. Do you really love animals, vet? When things don't go their way, they easily abandon both the suffering animals and their owners right in front of them. It's more expensive than other places, and the vet is like this, so I'm definitely never going back.

The phone manner is informal and disrespectful. The loud chatter can be heard even in the waiting room, making me feel uncomfortable. It feels like they have no awareness of the responsibility they have in dealing with people's lives. And the clinic director is only interested in the wealthy.

I had dental surgery done on my senior dog.

The vet and nurses were very kind, and I would definitely recommend this clinic for senior dog dental surgery.

I had a Cesarean section!

The scar is very clean, and both mother and baby are healthy 🐾 …

I think there are pros and cons.
I think the doctors' skills and intuition are good, but when I use this clinic occasionally, they treat me coldly unless I'm their regular doctor.
Personally, I find it unpleasant so I won't be going there anymore.

Thank you for your continued support.
Dr. Sonoda is calm but precise, and his injections are great, so my dog ​​loves him.

My 15-year-old cat was cared for at this hospital for the last four months of her life. Her kidney function declined, and initially I tried to administer IV fluids at home, but she was so unruly that I couldn't do it alone. So, I took her to the hospital every three days, and later every two days.

I felt a complex mix of guilt about not being able to give her IV fluids daily, or whether I was forcing her, but I was truly comforted by the doctors' words—they waited for me when I was unsure, and they answered as if it were perfectly normal, saying everything would be alright.

Previously, when my cat had lymphoma, I changed hospitals because the first one didn't meet my needs.

Ultimately, I believe finding a hospital that helps the owner feel positive is crucial to being able to say goodbye to their animals peacefully.

For me, this hospital was one that guided me through my uncertainties.
I'm glad I came to this hospital.

It's incredibly expensive... just a nail trim costs 2,000 yen.

This is the first time I've encountered a place that charges an additional consultation fee just for a nail trim appointment. Of course, I didn't ask any questions; they only weighed my dog. My dog ​​isn't even elderly.

Both the doctor and staff are very kind.
The doctor explains things carefully and gives his opinion on things like how long the symptoms will last and when they were transmitted.
He also gives injections right in front of me, which makes me feel at ease. My child gets very fussy when getting injections at other hospitals, but the doctor here seems to be very skilled.

I own two dogs, a Toy Poodle and a Schnauzer, and for about a year and a half, this has been my go-to veterinarian.

They have always been incredibly kind and attentive, even during emergencies, and have even come to see me on their days off. While I feel bad about bothering them as a pet owner, I am truly grateful!

They always understand my worries, even if they seem overprotective, and respond thoughtfully, explaining and answering my questions until I fully understand. I feel reassured and grateful every time.

The presence of the doctor and nurses is truly a great source of support for us pet owners, and I am filled with gratitude. Thank you so much for everything!

I hope to continue relying on this clinic as my trusted veterinarian for many years to come, so I look forward to your continued support (*^^*)

My senior dog had been suffering from itchy skin for many years, so I took him in for a checkup.

The sincere and dedicated care from the doctor and nurses convinced both me and my dog ​​that this is a trustworthy hospital we can confidently entrust our pet's care to. Thank you very much.

This is a trustworthy and wonderful veterinarian. I've decided not to go to any other hospitals.

This was the first animal hospital I went to after getting my first kitten, but after moving, it became a bit far, so I was going to a closer hospital.

My kitten hadn't urinated for two days, so I went to this hospital late one weekday evening. I also mentioned that my kitten had been having bloody stools for a while and had been examined multiple times at a nearby hospital, and had been taking medication prescribed for the past three weeks. The doctor explained his opinion and the reasons in detail. As a result, just as the doctor said, my kitten urinated that night, and I was able to stop the medication for the bloody stools. My kitten is healthy and fine. I truly regret not going here from the beginning.

Even though it was late at night, the doctor gave me a thorough and easy-to-understand explanation and reassured me that everything would be alright. Everyone working there is truly kind and wonderful to animals. Also, I think the fees are very reasonable. I'm so glad I found Nihonbashi Animal Hospital.

Although it's further from my home now, it's not an impossible distance, so I will continue to go here from now on. Thank you for your continued support.

My beloved dog, who has mitral valve insufficiency, received care at this hospital from 2022.

Five stars aren't enough to describe how wonderful the doctor is!

He never recommends unnecessary tests, and his medication prescriptions are always appropriate and perfect.

Because of his heart condition, I, as the owner, was quite anxious, and I asked many small questions and repeated the same things many times, but he never showed any displeasure and answered everything kindly and carefully.

I am truly sad and anxious that I will no longer be able to visit this hospital because I am moving to another prefecture.

At the last appointment, he performed tests and wrote down the test results, medications my dog ​​was taking, ultrasound images, and when he started taking the medication, so that the doctor at the next hospital would understand everything clearly.

I don't think you'll find many doctors who are this kind, caring, and sincere.

The reception staff and nurses are also very kind and helpful on the phone and at the hospital, which I think will bring comfort to any pet owner.

I highly recommend this hospital!

Thank you so much for three years of care.

I believe my beloved dog is living so stably thanks to you, Doctor.

I can't express my gratitude enough.

Please take care of yourselves, Doctor and all the nurses, and continue to save many animals.

Thank you so much!

While walking my 11-year-old female dog on the riverbank, she hurt her right hind leg while running. She was in pain and limping, so I immediately took her to our vet. She was diagnosed with an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) rupture and extraarticular surgery was recommended.

I was surprised by the surgery recommendation and took some time to research it myself. I learned that ligament ruptures are irreversible and damage to the meniscus, making prompt surgery necessary. I discovered that the current mainstream surgical method is tibial plateau leveling osteotomy (TPLO).

I searched for TPLO surgery and found the Nihonbashi Animal Hospital blog. The reviews mentioned their experience, fees, and the possibility of shorter hospital stays, so I immediately called and made an appointment.

After the examination, they said surgery was possible two days later, so I agreed.

My dog ​​is very timid, and I didn't want to put her through the emotional stress of hospitalization, so I requested a minimal stay.

Two days after the surgery, on Saturday morning, I received a call saying she could be discharged that day.

I was worried, but when I went to pick him up, he was happy. Of course, he looked like he was in pain and lacked energy; it was heartbreaking.
After returning home, seeing him get better day by day, I was so glad we shortened his hospital stay.
The swelling in his leg gradually subsided, and he stopped limping.
Two weeks after the surgery, he was walking without a limp.
Three weeks later, he was walking as if nothing had happened, which made me nervous!
I was constantly worried he would limp, but I'm relieved for now.
TPLO surgery is expensive, but considering my dog's well-being, I'm glad we chose it so he could recover quickly and walk again.
The doctor listened to our requests and provided detailed explanations; I consider him a trustworthy doctor.
I'm so glad I researched online!
I'm grateful to have found him.
We'll continue to rely on his services in the future.

The doctor speaks in a gentle, reassuring voice, and my cat is always quiet and calm without being scared. The nurses also gently hold and stroke the cat on the examination table, which seems to make the cat feel at ease. I look forward to continuing to work with you.

I've been to this hospital for my dog's anterior cruciate ligament surgery and health checkups. I visited several hospitals, but this one was the most affordable, so I chose it, and I'm so glad I did.

The doctors and nurses are all very kind, and I can feel that they treat pets with love and care. I asked many detailed questions, and they answered all of them patiently.

During the surgery, they explained everything in detail, and after the surgery, they provided thorough follow-up and explanations, so I was able to have the surgery with peace of mind.

This is a truly trustworthy animal hospital.

When my dog ​​was 2 years old, he underwent hip surgery here.

Now, at 7 years old, he has Grade 3 patellar disease.

He was initially treated at another hospital, but I was distrustful of the diagnosis, so I took him to Dr. Sonoda for a second opinion after several years!
As expected, the diagnosis at the first hospital was misdiagnosed, and he almost lost the ability to walk again on the leg that Dr. Sonoda had so carefully repaired. . . 😱
I realized the importance of a second opinion, and I'm so glad I had him treated here.

After consulting with Dr. Sonoda, they quickly arranged for surgery, and everything went smoothly. Now he can run properly on all fours again!! 🐶🐾
Dr. Sonoda and the nurses are all easy to talk to and consult with, making this a hospital I can trust with my dog! ✨
I plan to continue caring for my dog ​​here in the future. 🍀
They treated my little parakeet with great kindness and care.
The teacher is a nice person. He just looks tired.
Very attentive! The doctor is skilled at giving injections and provides thorough explanations, so I feel at ease and confident in his care.

I'm always grateful for your help.
My dog ​​was born small, so I took her to the doctor every time she had diarrhea or vomiting, and her careful treatment always made me feel at ease.
I also had her spayed, but the scars were clean from the start and are now invisible.
When she crushed and swallowed some plastic, you examined her right away, which was a huge help. ←You saved my life.
Your kind personality seems to be transmitted to the dog, so I can always visit you in a relaxed atmosphere.
I've had different doctors every time I've had a dog, but I think this doctor is the best because you can really feel the effort they put in on a daily basis.

I have been receiving your care for the past 14 years since I adopted my Scottish 🐈. Thank you for always giving me supportive advice as your doctor, even though I am often away from Tokyo due to frequent transfers. I look forward to continuing to rely on you in the future. …

We have been taking our dog to this vet for over 10 years, ever since he was a puppy. The vet always provides accurate diagnoses and treatments that we are satisfied with every time. He is a very trustworthy vet, and we can entrust our dog …

When my assignment to the United States was decided, I was in a panic, but the director of this hospital was extremely knowledgeable and quickly prepared all the necessary documents in perfect English. My dog ​​passed through quarantine …
